intro: Privacy law mentions in GitHub issues and Hugging Face Discussions.
pending: Pilot data are limited and preliminary; they are not scientific results.
cutoff: Inclusive content cutoff: September 22, 2026, UTC. Missing or invalid dates do not establish eligibility.
github: GitHub: global search for legal terms in public closed issues; repositories need an AI/ML signal and technical evidence. Pull requests and bot authors are excluded; bot comments may count.
hf: Hugging Face: models, datasets, Spaces and Kernels with closed Discussions. Pull requests and bot authors are excluded; bot comments are retained. Buckets have no Discussions; gated Spaces are excluded.
licenses: On both platforms, repositories must be public and use an SPDX license approved by the local OSI list. There is no popularity threshold.
concepts: The configuration preserves 20 concepts and the 24-category taxonomy; keywords do not assign categories automatically.
sampling: Units with legal evidence are stratified by platform, repository type and law. Cochran with finite population correction: 99% confidence, 5% margin and 50% proportion; sampled without replacement.
exports: Population, sample, strata and coding files are exported to inputs/final/collection. Raw data and tokens are not copied to the site.
full: --run collects both platforms and generates the site after analysis. Generation checks collection coverage and response integrity.
publication: Tests run on every push to main. After they pass, a separate workflow publishes the site to GitHub Pages.
limits: Textual mentions do not establish legal compliance. GitHub totals come from searches for laws; Hugging Face discovery depends on license indexing. The pilot is limited.
kernel_limit: The Kernel listing route still needs live validation of pagination and coverage.
rq_scope: GitHub and Hugging Face are included in all three questions. General OSS comparisons are part of RQ1 and RQ2.
rq1: Which privacy rights and principles are mentioned? Initial text is separated from comments.
rq2: Which concerns appear, and how do they relate to the study's 24 categories?
rq3: Which of the nine AI/ML/LLM development stages relate to the concerns?
no_collection: Scientific collection has not run yet.
preliminary_pilot: Preliminary preview based only on limited pilot data; these are not scientific results.
pilot: Preliminary, limited pilot data. Runs {github_run} (GitHub) and {hf_run} (Hugging Face), from {started} to {finished} UTC. Protocol {protocol_version}; cutoff {cutoff} UTC. Unique repositories: GitHub, {github_catalogued} catalogued, {github_eligible} eligible and {github_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions; Hugging Face, {hf_catalogued} catalogued, {hf_eligible} eligible and {hf_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions. Spaces: {spaces_scope}; Kernels: {kernels_scope}. Limits: up to {model_limit} discovered and {hf_eligible_limit} eligible repositories per HF type, {discussion_limit} Discussions per repository and up to {github_results_limit} search results per GitHub term. These counts do not represent the population.
official: Official full collection validated at {saved} UTC. Runs {github_run} (GitHub) and {hf_run} (Hugging Face). Verified coverage of unique repositories: GitHub, {github_catalogued} catalogued, {github_eligible} eligible and {github_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions; Hugging Face, {hf_catalogued} catalogued, {hf_eligible} eligible and {hf_evidence_repositories} with legal mentions.
collection_incomplete: The latest collections do not satisfy the protocol. Scientific results are pending.
analysis_pending: Collection complete. The sample has not been prepared yet.
